title: What is SIP?
content: SIP stands for Systematic Investment Plan. It allows you to invest a fixed amount regularly in mutual funds.

title: Power of Compounding
content: Compounding means earning returns on your returns. Starting early multiplies wealth exponentially.

title: Risk vs Return
content: Higher potential returns come with higher risk. Understanding your risk tolerance is key to investing.

title: Diversification
content: Spreading investments across asset classes reduces risk. Do not put all eggs in one basket.

title: Inflation and Investing
content: Inflation erodes purchasing power. Investing helps your money grow faster than inflation.

title: Mutual Funds Explained
content: Mutual funds pool money from many investors to buy a diversified portfolio managed by professionals.

title: Market Cycles
content: Markets go through bull and bear phases. Long-term investors benefit by staying invested through cycles.

title: Goal-Based Investing
content: Align your investments with specific goals like education or travel to stay motivated and on track.
